item.title: Ezra 9, True Repentance and the Mercy of God
item.description: In this episode of Reading the Bible Daily with Dave, we walk through Ezra 9 and see what true repentance looks like—holy grief over sin and renewed hope in God's covenant mercy. Ezra’s prayer of confession points us to Christ, our perfect Intercessor, who provides forgiveness and restoration through His finished work.

item.title: Christ’s Birth and the Fulfillment of God’s Promises
item.description: In this episode of Equipping You in Grace, Dave Jenkins examines how Christ’s birth fulfills God’s promises through prophecy, Scripture reliability, and God’s sovereignty. This episode explores eight reflections on the Incarnation and how fulfilled prophecy shapes a biblical worldview.
